color.global.separator.element: hairline between rows on app (Yope-referenced) surfaces
color.global.separator.evidence: references/auto/locket/apk/locket-1.243.0-hermes-excerpts.txt (Locket Android 1.243.0, decompiled Hermes JS bundle): grouped option list StyleSheet 'divider' = {height: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, backgroundColor: WHITE20} with WHITE20 = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)' (rows minHeight 56 in a WHITE10 radius-15 group on a black screen); action-sheet 'separator' = height 1, WHITE10, marginHorizontal 12
color.global.separator.notes: Gap fill (MERGE 'Gap fill' G2-1). Yope draws no row divider (it separates items with gaps, size.global.listGap); Locket is a dark-only photo app whose lists sit on black like Yope's deep surfaces, and it divides rows inside its grouped lists with a white 20 % hairline. Draw it 1 physical pixel thick (iOS 1 / displayScale pt, Android 1 px). Over #000000 it reads #333333 (1.66:1), over #171717 #454545 (1.87:1): a decorative boundary, the rows are identified by their text. System surfaces keep color.global.system.ios.separator / color.global.system.outline.
color.global.separator.method: source constant read from the decompiled bundle (hermes-dec); rgba(255,255,255,0.2) -> #FFFFFF33 (0.2 x 255 = 51)
color.global.separator.precision: exact (source constant); line width = the platform hairline (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth: 1 physical pixel)

layout.global.appearance.element: appearance of every surface (app and system)
layout.global.appearance.evidence: Yope is dark in every source: neither research pass records a light-appearance Yope screen in the 7 App Store PNGs and 5 Play PNGs (2026), the press kit (Jul 2026) or the 14 TikTok screen recordings (2024-2026) (design/research/yope-a.md §0.1, design/research/yope-b.md §0). references/auto/yope/frames/a-yrrah-7454430216123862280-t21.23-photos-permission-alert-2024.png: the iOS system alert renders in light appearance over Yope's dark group screen, i.e. the device was in light mode and Yope still drew dark. HIG Dark Mode (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/dark-mode, change log 2024-08-06): 'In rare cases, consider using only a dark appearance in the interface. For example, it can make sense for an app that supports immersive media viewing to use a permanently dark appearance'. Apple: UIUserInterfaceStyle 'Set this value to force the dark user interface style, even when the systemwide style is set to light' (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information-property-list/uiuserinterfacestyle).
layout.global.appearance.method: reference observation + HIG allowance; mechanism from Apple documentation
layout.global.appearance.notes: In 2024 Yope let system alerts follow the device (light); the 2026 videos show dark alerts (cause not determinable). Forcing dark app-wide follows the HIG mechanism for system surfaces — MERGE_DECISIONS F-1 (owner confirm).
